issue.title: bob projects sync ignores .md-suffixed parent links like [[love.md|love]] that the new_note template writes

task_type_fields.impact: Nine live vault notes use the `[[x.md|x]]` parent form, all created by `_templates/new_note.md`: the typed areas `family` and `vacation` (parent `[[love.md|love]]`), plus `haircut`, `tv`, `legacy_job`, `legacy_gkeep_notes`, `bob_ref`, `groceries`, and `groceries_260701`. Any `projects/scan.rs` consumer (projects sync Sub-projects lines, tree walks) treats their parent as missing, while root-parent attribution resolves it, so the views disagree. The planned notebook type (research `research:202611/bob_notebooks/bob_notebooks__final.md`, V11) needs one path-aware parent resolver. Fix: make scan.rs accept a `.md` suffix (or share the path resolver), and change the vault template to write `[[stem]]`.
task_type_fields.repro:
Reproduce in a scratch vault (bob 0.5.0, bob-cli f231b9d3):

1. `dev.md` area; `proj.md` project with `parent: "[[dev]]"`.
2. `proj_a.md` project with `parent: "[[proj.md|proj]]"` (the form `~/bob/_templates/new_note.md` writes).
3. `proj_b.md` project with `parent: "[[proj]]"`.
4. `bob projects sync -b <vault> --dry-run`

Observed: `would add [[proj_b]] to ^prj` for `proj`, but `proj_a` is never added to the Sub-projects line.
Expected: both children, because Obsidian resolves `[[proj.md|proj]]` to `proj.md`.

Cause: `src/native/projects/scan.rs` `wikilink_ref_from_inner` (line ~1080) keeps the `.md` suffix, so `link_name` is `proj.md` and matches no note stem. The root-parent walk (`src/native/pomodoro_homes/facts.rs:120`, `wikilink_path_target`) resolves the same link by path, so the two parent parsers disagree.

issue.creation_reason: Found while verifying parent resolution for the notebook note-type research: bob's projects scan and root-parent walk disagree on `[[x.md|x]]` parent links, which the vault's new_note template writes.
